name: Gallery Cab Car
manufacturer: Budd Company, Pullman-Standard, St. Louis Car, American Car & Foundry, Canadian Vickers, Amerail, Nippon Sharyo
description: The Gallery Car is a bilevel rail car, originally created by the Budd Company in 1950 for Commuter Operations on the Chicago, Burlington & Quincy Railroad's Suburban Service. Besides Budd, it has had six total different manufacturers since its creation, being Pullman-Standard, St. Louis Car Company, American Car & Foundry, Canadian Vickers, Amerail, and Nippon Sharyo. Many of these double-decker passenger cars were built by Budd and Pullman-Standard between the 1950s and 1970s for various passenger rail operators in the United States, with a small order by Canadian Vickers for service in Canada.
